Callout.Name: Fraud Report
Callout.Advisory: Suspect left some time ago, details with staff.

Script.Line: It came off the account this morning. Two thousand.
I have the printout here, and the transaction number on it.
I have never been to that shop. Never in my life.

Lines.Approach: He is long gone but the staff have everything written down for you.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
